case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

sup:70620.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for your quote; we have reviewed it and propose the terms below.

We commit to a binding volume of 20000 pieces a year over 24 months, our full need for this part, as in our demand forecast (fc:360020@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery averaged 85.9% over the last two scorecard quarters (sc:70620@2026Q2, sc:70620@2026Q3).
Our orders for this part rose from EUR 4.29 in 2025-10 to EUR 4.39 in 2026-09 (po:4500013039-10, po:4500014467-10); you already raised the price within the last year.

We have set out 3 packages below. Each would be an acceptable basis for agreement for us; if none fits, please tell us which term is the hardest for you:
1. EUR 4.35 per unit, payment 14 days net, 24 months
2. EUR 4.36 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months
3. EUR 4.35 per unit, payment 14 days net, 36 months

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part? And what would you need from us to move further on the price?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

sup:70620.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €4.87 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we appreciate your commitment to 20,000 pieces over 24 months, which allows us to revise our offer to EUR 4.88 per unit with 30 days net payment, offering a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Regarding your request, please understand that we do not share internal cost breakdowns as a matter of company policy. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. To consider any further adjustments to the price, we would need a significant increase in the committed volume. Which volume can you commit to? This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

sup:70620.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for your revised offer.

We commit to a binding volume of 20000 pieces a year over 24 months, our full need for this part.

Below are 2 packages we could sign. If one term is the obstacle, please name it:
1. EUR 4.39 per unit, payment 14 days net, 24 months
2. EUR 4.40 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months

What would you need from us to move further?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

sup:70620.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer and your continued commitment to the volume of 20,000 pieces. We value our partnership and have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We can make a slight adjustment to EUR 4.86 per unit for a 24-month contract with 14 days net payment. For our current Angebot, we present a price of €4.86 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

As this represents our limit under the current conditions, any further price movement would require a significant increase in your annual volume. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

sup:70620.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.

We commit to a binding volume of 20000 pieces a year over 24 months, our full need for this part.

We have set out 2 packages below. Each would be an acceptable basis for agreement for us; if none fits, please tell us which term is the hardest for you:
1. EUR 4.42 per unit, payment 14 days net, 24 months
2. EUR 4.43 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months

What is the best price you could sign on one of these packages?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

sup:70620.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised proposal; however, we have reached the absolute limit of our pricing flexibility. As a reliable partner, we always strive to support your business with our extensive range and high service standards, but this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our final offer stands at a price of €4.86 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. We cannot accommodate any further price reductions for the committed volume of 20,000 pieces. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

Kindly keep in mind that this offer remains valid for 7 days. We truly appreciate our ongoing business relationship and hope to continue working together.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
